notes: Provisional visual shortlist. Ownership, finished status, and print validation remain for the owner to confirm. No redistribution license selected.

models.title: Robot
models.summary: A single rigged robot, shown with its isolated 24-frame walking cycle.
models.selection_reason: Only the rigged RobotPlayerMesh and its 27-bone armature; isolate Walking frames 1–25 rather than the combined Everything timeline or older rigid variants.

models.title: Grumpy Old Man
models.summary: An expressive character sculpt exploring exaggerated facial features.
models.selection_reason: Primary Character mesh with matching InnerEye. Exclude older Character.002 and the alternative eye shells.

models.title: Terror Bird
models.summary: A creature modeling study built around a long neck, heavy beak, and compact body.
models.selection_reason: Single coherent creature mesh; no complete rig or animation is present. Use as a clay study.

models.title: Belt Holder
models.summary: A compact organizer design for hanging belts.
models.selection_reason: Only STL export in the project (September 23); its 4,024 triangles and bounds match Cube.001. Excludes the long reference cylinders and cutter block.

models.title: Purse Holder
models.summary: A hanging storage design with a curved support and compact mounting geometry.
models.review_notes: Source includes objects named GeometricWallHook_V1. Confirm whether geometry was imported or is original.
models.selection_reason: Latest complete STL export, October 15 at 13:49. Matches GeometricWallHook_V1.001; exclude the taller predecessor and Clearance test coupon.

models.title: Microscope Holder
models.summary: A custom holder design exploring a stable fit for a microscope.
models.review_notes: Source includes object named czfa_flexframe_mount-mount-additional-movement-1-2. Confirm whether this is a remix and identify the source.
models.selection_reason: Only the saved active mount mesh; discard Cylinder and Cube reference/cutting objects.

models.title: Under Desk Drawer — Small
models.summary: The October 14 small drawer, top and matching rails, shown partly open to reveal the assembly.
models.review_notes: Scene contains numerous alternative parts and reference shapes. Select the actual assembly before exporting print files.
models.selection_reason: Latest coherent four-part set, exported together October 14 at 21:38. STL coordinates match the four zz _ Small objects exactly. Excludes September full-width variants and all reference blocks.

models.title: Arduino Case
models.source: Arduino Case witj mini breadboard and joystick on top/Ardunio Base.blend
models.summary: An enclosure concept for an Arduino, a small breadboard, and a joystick.
models.selection_reason: Saved selected/active final combined enclosure mesh; all earlier base, joystick, peg, and switch studies are hidden in the source and excluded.

models.title: Whiteboard Easel Support
models.summary: One back-support component from the easel development scene.
models.selection_reason: Latest numbered back support is a coherent single component. Excludes overlapping back.001, separate bracket studies, rods and test cylinders.

models.title: Sensor Drawer
models.summary: The latest exported drawer variant with a label slot and a longer handle.
models.review_notes: Scene includes Stackable Drawer Open Concept and holder variants. Check relation to downloaded drawer designs.
models.selection_reason: Latest complete drawer STL export on September 25 at 02:09, later than the stackable-shell and v1–v4 sensor tests. Export only this component, not two overlaid storage-box variants.

models.title: Main Character
models.source: Blender/GO THROUGH - determine if they should be exported and added to portfolio/Unnamed Main Character.blend
models.summary: A character development study exploring a human silhouette and pose.
models.selection_reason: Only one skinned Character and its matching armature with Walking.001; excludes the second rig and every loose modeling-part alternative.

models.title: Keyboard Riser
models.summary: A low-profile perforated riser for a keyboard.
models.selection_reason: The project has one complete 620-triangle STL export dated May 12; use this coherent single part rather than reconstructing a source scene.

models.title: iPad Wall Mount — Remix
models.source: iPad Wall Mount/Full Bottom Remix v2.stl
models.summary: The second full-width revision of a wall-mount design.
models.selection_reason: Latest full bottom STL, October 14 at 17:05. v2 retains the same topology while widening the full support from 283.86 to 287.87 raw STL units. Exclude the earlier bottom and tiny corner test.

models.title: Triceratops
models.source: Blender/GO THROUGH - determine if they should be exported and added to portfolio/Triceratops.blend
models.summary: A low-poly dinosaur study with a broad frill and three horns.
models.selection_reason: One coherent 3,195-face creature mesh, with no overlapping alternatives or helper meshes.

models.title: Mushroom Study
models.source: Blender/GO THROUGH - determine if they should be exported and added to portfolio/Mushrooms.blend
models.selection_reason: A single named 2,447-face mesh, separated from generic cube and shader tests.

models.title: Standard Model of Particle Physics
models.source: Blender/GO THROUGH - determine if they should be exported and added to portfolio/Standard Model.blend
models.summary: A spatial arrangement of particle names and families, built as a Blender diagram.
models.selection_reason: The visible diagram consists of two label bars, Text, the converted particle-physics lettering, and the Bosons group. Hidden alternative labels and scene lights are excluded.

models.title: Mansion Study
models.source: Blender/GO THROUGH - determine if they should be exported and added to portfolio/Mansion.blend
models.summary: A multi-level architectural study with exterior stairs and a covered entrance.
models.selection_reason: Use the coherent visible architectural assembly; exclude source cameras and lights. Review the rendered result before featuring.
